tree.heading: Board of Directors.—
tree.text: The board of directors and the responsibilities of the board are as provided in the articles of incorporation.

tree.heading: Officers.—
tree.text: The officers and the election of officers are as provided in the articles of incorporation.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 150106(a)36:2306.Apr. 10, 1984, Pub. L. 98–257, §§ 6, 7, 98 Stat. 128. 150106(b)36:2307. The words “and in conformity with the laws of the State or States in which it is incorporated” in 36:2306 and “and in conformity with the laws of the State or States wherein it is incorporated” in 36:2307 are omitted as unnecessary.
